whenToUse: The most important action on the screen, such as Save or Send.
It must be obvious that something can be pressed.
whenNotToUse: It moves to another page (use a link).
A state that turns on and off (use a toggle button or a switch).
One area needs several primary buttons (sort out the hierarchy first).

alternatives.name: Icon Button
alternatives.reason: Space is tight and an icon conveys the meaning.

accessibility: Set type on native button elements so they don't submit a form by accident.
The keyboard focus ring shows only with :focus-visible, so it doesn't bother mouse users.
The slight shrink on press turns off with reduced motion.
Keep text contrast at 4.5:1 or more and heights of 32–40px so they're easy to press.
